text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If AI systems learn from data that contains human prejudices, they can make unfair decisions in areas like hiring or lending. Fairness means we must actively check and correct these problems. Privacy is another issue, as AI often uses large amounts of personal data. People deserve to know how their information is collected and used, so transparency is essential. This means companies should explain how their algorithms work in simple language. Finally, responsible AI development requires collaboration between engineers, ethicists, and the public. By considering these values from the start, we can build technology that helps everyone, not just a few.
